steps.title: From install to first formation
steps.sub: No accounts, no sign-up. FPLN walks you through everything the first time it opens.

items.d: One click above. FPLN gets its own window, a taskbar and Start-menu icon, and it works offline.
Pick your class and company, switch on minute calls and your alarm, test the sound and choose a theme.
Load your BUFF card or syllabi so FPLN fills in your week. Updates arrive by themselves; you never download it again.

trust.t: Your data stays on your device
trust.d: Nothing you enter is uploaded; there's no account and no server holding your plan. Automatic safety checks run on every update. Keep CUI out of FPLN: no FRAGORDs, rosters or other cadets' personal information.

items.q: Do I ever need to download it again?
items.a: No. FPLN checks for a newer version every time it opens and while it runs. When one is ready you'll see “Update ready · Restart now.”

items.q: Will the alarm work with the screen off?
items.a: Yes, while FPLN is open. On a laptop, keep it plugged in. The Windows download includes “FPLN keep awake”, which stops Windows from sleeping while plugged in (and an undo file). For extra safety, Wake up › Back up alarms to my phone.

items.q: Where is my data, and who can see it?
items.a: Only on the device you use, inside the browser that runs FPLN. Nothing goes to a server, and no one else can see it. More › Backup moves it to a new computer.

items.q: The Install button didn't do anything.
items.a: FPLN may already be installed: look for it in your Start menu or taskbar. Otherwise, in Edge or Chrome open the ⋯ menu › Apps › Install this site as an app. Firefox can't install apps; use Edge or Chrome, or just use FPLN in the browser.
Open FPLN, click ⋯ at the top right › Uninstall. On a phone, press and hold the icon › Remove.

items.q: Is this an official USMA app?
items.a: No. FPLN is a cadet project in beta, not an official USMA or U.S. Army product. Send feedback with the speech-bubble button in the app.
